<cite ref="Zevachim 95a:3">Zeb. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>דרָצֵיף ליה מִירְּצַף</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דרציף מרציף</he>) when he closes the hole up by hammering.
Gen. R. s. 7 רְצוֹף רצפך וכ׳ hammer away thy hammering (strike me), for it is good for learning; [‘Rashi’: (the teacher saying to him that is punished) pave thy paving, i.e. lie down; v. רָצַף].
